golden_baseline_location: scripts/tp_portal/golden/portal-golden-transcript.json (recorded from a fresh local monolith per scripts/tp_portal/transcript_spec.json)

acceptance_checks.description: Replay of the 20-step golden transcript against the decomposed estate on fresh tables passes 20/20: status codes exact; bodies compared as parsed JSON; createdAt validated as ISO-8601 then normalized; assert_status_only steps compare status only.
A second reset-and-replay pass is also 20/20 (rerun evidence carried in the recon report).
Declared ApiException maps to its 4xx body (parity); unexpected/infrastructure exceptions propagate so AWS/Lambda Errors increments and the per-context alarm plus the gateway 5xx alarm can fire.
Every resource carries the ow-tp-portal-<ns>- prefix and Project=otterworks-tp tag; nothing with hourly idle cost.

planted_anomalies.description: GET /api/announcements/999 on a store with 2 rows must return the monolith's 404 error body.
POST /api/feedback with rating=6 must be rejected with a 400 (framework validation body is status-only per the transcript spec).
Deliberate infrastructure fault (missing table) driving Errors metric >= 1 and alarm OK->ALARM->OK; live-only, owned by the parent's validation window.
planted_anomalies.reason: Fixture (child) runs never touch live AWS; the parent proves the fault path once in a throwaway namespace.

encoding_policy.input_encoding: UTF-8 JSON request/response bodies; base64-encoded API Gateway payloads are decoded as UTF-8 explicitly; percent-encoded path segments are decoded per segment ('+' stays literal) to match Spring @PathVariable decoding.
encoding_policy.byte_transparency: Not byte-transparent: bodies are compared as parsed JSON values (serializer whitespace/key order are out of contract); timestamp fields are validated as ISO-8601 instants then normalized to '<instant>'.
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: Malformed percent-escapes in a path segment are rejected with 400; invalid UTF-8 in a JSON body is rejected as a malformed body (400).

malformed_record_policy.details: Unknown JSON fields in request bodies are ignored (Jackson non-strict binding, matching the monolith). Missing/blank required fields (title, body, userId, message) and out-of-range ratings (outside 1-5) are rejected with 400; NULLs never fail open into stored records.

empty_input_semantics.details: Empty stores are a served state, not an error: GET /api/announcements returns [], GET /api/feedback/average-rating returns 0.0, and unknown users get default preferences (light/en-US/email-on) without creating a row. Empty or missing request bodies on POST/PUT are rejected with 400.

trigger_granularity_note: Synchronous request/response: one API Gateway event per HTTP request invokes exactly one Lambda ('per-file' is the schema's closest enum value to per-request); no batching. Async/event-driven flows belong to the events unit, not this one.
